name: Cove Stake & Wood Products Inc
old_description: Since 1987, Cove Stake & Wood Products has been your local manufacturer and wholesaler of wooden stakes, slats, pallets, and crates.
about:
Cove Stake & Wood Products Inc has operated from Martinsburg, Pennsylvania since 1987. The company was established as a family-owned and operated business and continues under that ownership today, serving customers across the United States from its Curryville Road location.

The company manufactures and wholesales a range of wooden products including stakes, slats, lath, rough-cut lumber, pallets, and crates. A two-step quality process is used to reduce rejects and breakage, aiming to lower total costs for buyers. Production volumes, facility size, and employee headcount are not publicly disclosed.

Customers span residential, commercial, and construction sectors, with specific mention of surveying jobs that use stakes and lath. The firm also supplies pallets and crates for material handling and shipping needs across those same markets.

The business emphasizes competitive pricing, on-time delivery, and free estimates as part of its value proposition. Its longevity and family ownership are presented as indicators of reliability, while the quality-control process is cited as a differentiator that reduces waste and cost for end users.
